general.descriptionTextModule: Manage UCP — the open standard for agentic commerce. Configure capabilities, signing keys and platform allowlists per sales channel.

list.headline: UCP Configuration
list.intro: UCP makes your shop discoverable for AI commerce agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, …). Enable it per sales channel and configure which capabilities to expose.

detail.headline: UCP Configuration
detail.activeHelp: When active, /.well-known/ucp is served on every domain of this sales channel.
detail.versionHelp: Date-based UCP protocol version this channel advertises (YYYY-MM-DD).
detail.continueUrlTemplateHelp: Optional override for the fallback URL returned to agents when they need to hand the user back to the storefront. Placeholders: {domainUrl}, {cartToken}.
detail.capabilitiesIntro: Capabilities define which UCP features agents may use for this sales channel. Root capabilities are standalone areas; extensions enrich existing flows such as cart or checkout.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Features agents use to discover products and retrieve concrete product details.

commerce.title: Cart, checkout and order
commerce.description: The core shopping flow from cart creation through checkout completion to order status and webhooks.

extensions.title: Checkout extensions
extensions.description: Optional extensions that enrich cart or checkout responses with discounts, fulfillment, consent or loyalty data.

identity.title: Identity and OAuth
identity.description: OAuth 2.0 account linking so agents can use customer-approved identity or order data.

capabilityHelp.catalogSearchHelp: Allows agents to discover products via text search or filters. This is usually the entry point for shopping flows.
capabilityHelp.catalogLookupHelp: Allows agents to fetch product details and variants after they have found products through search.
capabilityHelp.cartHelp: Allows agents to create, read, update and cancel carts.
capabilityHelp.checkoutHelp: Allows agents to create checkout sessions from carts, provide buyer data and complete checkout.
capabilityHelp.orderHelp: Allows order status reads and order webhooks back to the platform after checkout or fulfillment events.
capabilityHelp.discountHelp: Extends cart and checkout with discount codes and applied discounts. Requires cart or checkout as the parent capability.
capabilityHelp.fulfillmentHelp: Extends checkout with delivery destinations, shipping methods, options and later fulfillment events.
capabilityHelp.buyerConsentHelp: Stores and echoes buyer consent such as marketing or analytics choices in the checkout context.
capabilityHelp.loyaltyHelp: Extension point for loyalty programs. No program data is returned until a provider is connected.
capabilityHelp.identityLinkingHelp: Enables OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE so buyers can deliberately link their shop account to a platform.

detail.transportsHelp: Transports define which technical protocols agents can use for this sales channel. REST is the baseline HTTP API. MCP exposes the same commerce operations as JSON-RPC tools for agentic clients.
detail.signingKeysHelp: Signing keys are the public/private keys for this sales channel. Shopware uses them to sign UCP responses, order webhooks and AP2 merchant authorizations; platforms verify the signatures via /.well-known/ucp. During rotation, the old key stays in retiring state briefly so active platforms can still verify.
detail.noKeyPrivilege: You need the ucp.key_rotator privilege to manage signing keys.
detail.previewHint: Click "Load preview" to see the JSON profile that will be served at /.well-known/ucp for this sales channel.
detail.keyRotated: Signing key rotated. Previous key is now in retiring state for 24 hours.

signaturePolicyOptions.log: log (verify and log failures, accept request — staging only)

detail.signaturePolicyHelp: How strictly RFC 9421 signatures on inbound platform requests are verified. Production must use "strict" — invalid or missing signatures will reject the request.
detail.signaturePolicyNonStrictWarning: Signature policy is not "strict". This is acceptable for local simulator use, but production deployments must use "strict" to prevent unsigned requests from being accepted.
detail.idempotencyRequiredHelp: Reject non-idempotent UCP requests (cart create, checkout complete, …) when the Idempotency-Key header is missing. Recommended on for production.
